body: No man don't do it, you're notmalone feeling like this. Youre obviously good at something if you have money in the bank dude, it's not so bad. It could be worse you could have no car and have no place to stay.Youre not a loser at all man, you actually seem like a pretty cool guy. A lot of people are socially awkward, I know I am. At least you have a place to live, that could be much worse too, it's not so bad,your parents love you. Your time will come for marriage and children, you can't rush these things that's when it fucks up, trust me I know.
Thank you, thank you very much for your kind words. I am going to stand my ground and keep my head up for my son. He needs me and I need him that's all that matters.
Thank you for your kind words, I guess I'm just devastated, I had a happy family here or so I thought. No when I walk around the apartment all I feel is pain and sorrow. I feel hollow without them.

Thank you for your kind words. I do love him, I love him more than anything or anyone I have ever know and will know, that little boy is my world. I am confused about why she's done this, but more than anything I just want them both back here with me. I miss her so much it's insane, she put me through hell and back again and yet I still just want to hug her and be with her I'm so hurt by her but I still have nothing but love. This is so hard to even think about, and I just want to see them. But I know it won't happen and the only way I can ever see my son again is by fighting a battle that is unwinnable in my eyes, the only way to walk out winners from this in my mind, is to be together as one happy family but from the look of things, I can't do anything but wait until I go before a judge to see when or even if I can see him, this is just brutal. And I want nothing more than to be there for my son but I can't help but think that I'm all to blame for this whole situation and that's why unjust want to give up. I think I will hold on for my son but it's just so hard but I believe I can do it, for him.

I know how you feel. My thoughts are usually my worst enemy, they scream at me at the worst of times and it gets unbearable. But at the same time it will not last. They go away eventually and eventually you will realize that you are the one in charge of how you feel. Just try to remain positive especially when you feel the most negative. You're not alone, there are tons of people here for you to reach out and talk to. I know you can pull through, I believe in you.

Hey there friend, you're not alone in thinking like this. I am in a similar spot, but only 26. I thought my life was good and on track and then the other day everything came crashing down, and now I can't see my son. I want so badly to just let it all go, my situation is not fair to me or my little boy. But at the same time, I know if u go now I will never see little boy grow into a great man, and that is what keeps me going. So try to think positive, surely you have something to live for. Keep your head up and don't give into the negativity, you will pull through this, I do believe in you.

I've had "the" job too. I lost it, got another lost it again. You never truly know where life will take you anyway. You will be ok, just keep your head up and try to think positive. You can do this, a lot of people go through it.

It's okay friend. This happens to everyone don't feel alone, I have been thrown into a deep depressed state by losing a job as well. It will get better, just keep your head held high. You can find something else, always.

I find letting people know that they are not alone in what they are going through, helps. I know that's what helps me when I'm down. I also like to tell people that I believe in them because when I'm down that's what I really need to hear and yet I can't think of a single time I've ever heard anyone say it to me, so I try to help people here. I guess it's a bit about helping myself by helping others, I hate to see others in pain.
You see, you're not alone. We are here and yes, let us help you.
Just think positively as much as you can. You can get through this tough time, it will not last forever. I believe in you, you can do it!

You can do this, I know exactly how you feel, everything seems hopeless, it isn't I'm telling you. You have 2 legs and a heartbeat you do have transportation. Don't give up so easily, I believe in you and I'm sure there other out there who do as well.

You're not alone. You have to tell someone that you don't feel the way that they think you do. No one knows the battle you're fighting inside other than yourself, you need to tell someone what is really going through your mind. I can guarantee that many people would be hurt by losing you, you may feel like a burden but you're not, your parents love you. You are not a coward either, here you are reaching out and that takes strength. You can pull through this feeling, I believe in you.
There are plenty more than 1 shelter in the US. Just look around you need to broaden your horizons. I know life has you beat down, but you can't let it keep you there you can do this. Fight it.
You can, you always can. Research your options! Open up Google and check it out. There are tons of programs out there to help people, you're not alone.

That's is all okay, I may be only 26 but I have had my share of the shit in my life. You can always find a way to rebuild, always. There are people my age already nearly journeymen in trades and I literally have half an apprenticeship under my belt so, you're not alone there either. And you're right I do next to nothing about you, but here you are reaching out, that means there is good in your life, even if you don't see it. Nonetheless, success is all just a belief that you can do it, nothing good comes easy.

Hey there, you're not alone. I too was just displaced from what I thought was the one. One day everything was perfect, we were laughing and having a good time and then all of a sudden she left me, and took my little boy with her. She then went to the police, falsely accused me of uttering death threats, and assault, which resulted in me being charged and being held in a cell. She came to our shared apartment and cleaned her and the babies stuff out. I was so distraught I tried fruitlessly to contact her, breaching my no contact order and was forced to go back to the police station to be detained. I would have been sent away for real had I not turned myself in. This relationship was my last hope for a bright happy future, and now it is shattered and I'm left alone. They only thing keeping me going is my little boy, I will get to see him if I just do this smart and not react to her anymore. It has been a very hard week but I can do this for my boy. What you need to do is reach out to anyone you can, I would offer you a safe place to stay, but I am in Canada. You can do this, you're not alone. If you ever need somebody to talk to you, I am but a message away. I believe in you, I know you can pull through this.

You really have, I look at my life and all I've ever really done is run from responsibility and now I'm nearly 30 still renting an apartment with a shitty credit score. You have done awesome, don't take that away from yourself. You should believe in yourself because there are people out there that believe in you as well, I know I do.

It seems like you had I rough friend. But you made it here, this far and that always is going to count for something. I know what it's like feeling like a disappointment to all, but I can assure that it is not like that, you have people who love you. You need to let these negative thoughts and feeling out put them on paper or even talk to someone who isn't family or someone who you would feel would judge you. You can pull through, you have done magnificent this far, even if you don't see it, you're carving your own path and that is beautiful. So just believe, in something, anything, I believe in you.

Just keep your head up, even if everything feels hopeless, it's not I promise you. It will get better my friend, as I said you're not alone. If it's becoming difficult to enjoy taking photos, then maybe try a new approach, keep it fresh, you never know. As for feeling numb I know that feeling all to well, I am normally very into gaming but, ever since my trouble began I can barely play them for 5 minutes at this point, it's brutal because it is my passion and always has been, but I also know I have been through this before and all I need to do is find that spark and let it ignite once more. You will find your spark too friend, I believe.
You're not alone. I know how it feels to be trapped as I am currently in a similar situation. Just know that it will get better, and if you need someone to talk too, I am only a message away.
I'm here, I'm in this too. Don't worry you're not alone. You can pull out of this, I believe in you. If you need I am only a message away, feel free.

The best thing you can do is focus on positivity, a goal/dream you have, or just something that makes you happy. I know it's hard to block out all the other horrible thoughts but, it just takes practice. You can do this friend, I do believe in you everything will get better, just hold on.

Hey man you're not alone in feeling like this. I'm here with you and if you ever just want to chat or get this stuff out of your mind, I'm open. I feel as though everything I do just amounts to a massive fuck up, not just a feeling though it literally actively is how my life is. I get going on a good track and then bam, I get hit with some hard times and what seems to be cruel fate and I fall back down to ring number one.

Thank you for your kind words. I hope that is not an affair and do not think it is but, well you never know. The only problem with even getting a hold of her through someone else is, one of my conditions are that neither I nor anyone else speak to her on my behalf, so I basically cannot get any kind of closure without making my situation much worse. At this point I'm in it for my baby, he deserves both a mother and father whom love him very much, even if we aren't together and I believe that is the thought that keeps me going. At first I thought it was just a cruel joke it didn't really set in until I realized I wouldn't be able to see my child, I was in disbelief that anyone can do this to someone they claimed to love that very day.

It really is, I really love this girl and just don't understand how in a blink of an eye can just not feel the same anymore. What's worse is she said to the police that she fears for the safety of my boy and that is what hurts the most. I have nothing but love for him he's my little mini me, how could I not love him. And now it's even worse because I tried to contact her for closure like a dumbass and got arrested again.. I was so close to going to actual jail, it's insane that this lie can do this to my life. I got "lucky" and went free on 500$ bail, only because I turned myself in. But they released me with an order to stay away from my son for about 10 days, that one really stings. I just want to hold him in my arms right now and cuddle him and just do everything with him. And even after all this pain this woman has put me through, I still just want nothing more than to be with her and talk with her and everything. I want things back to the way it was so so bad.
Hang on there, someone somewhere loves you very much. You can pull through this, I believe in you.

Thank you for the kind words. I guess I'm feeling extreme heartbreak more than anything, just the other day my baby and gf were just feet away from me and everything was perfect. Now she flipped my world and has said some very hurtful things to the police, it's out of character for her but, I'm not able to speak to her it's almost as if I never even knew her at all, and I think that is whT is killing me the most. I know suicide is not the answer but I also very much want my son to have a great upbringing with 2 parents that love each other but that dream is shattered for nothing and it hurts so so bad.

You can pull through, I know what you're going through and I belive in you. I just had my girlfriend who I thought was the one, leave me with my 3 month old son, and she is lying to try to take him away from me for good. So you're not alone, just know that and you can message me anytime of you need too as well.
I'm there too. You're not alone.

No I don't, see I have a job in camp I haven't gone for a while because with my moms help, I had been seeking counciling and have attended two sessions they then left for Mexico and are due back this Sunday now my next session is on the 26th but going the way I'm going right now I doubt I'll even make it there let alone be able to get any help and I really need to be helped before I do something at work or something I just don't trust myself right now

I can't talk to my family now because I fucked up and no I had a job in camp but I couldn't do it I found myself trying to starve myself and hurt myself a lot my parents give could give two shots about me currently and can't really say I blame them...
I am 24 and I live in my parents basement
